headline: Copper Prices Steady Above $5.50 Per Pound After Tech-Driven Sell-Off
summary: LME copper futures stabilized above $5.50 per pound after briefly dropping below $12,000 per ton amid a broad unwinding of artificial intelligence-related trades and a stronger US dollar.
why: Copper is a key industrial metal widely viewed as a economic indicator due to its use in power networks, electronics, and construction.
